summary.text: Giant Sun's true inheritances in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building are not one pool of equal prizes. They are graded.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan combines owner tokens to ten-edges, he enters the true inheritance secluded domain. Mo Yao’s will says that with ten-edges he can only receive the lowest grade, ordinary true inheritance. A bowl-sized lump of red starlight is that grade. Consciousness can enter it to read the contents, and the inheritance still has a test. Fang Yuan survives that test. With the ten-edge owner token, he already has the authority to inherit it. Fang Yuan already treats unparalleled true inheritance as a greater grade above ordinary.
The place itself is covered on true inheritance secluded domain.

The secluded domain is extremely huge, and the inheritances move. Mo Yao says there are only a few unparalleled true inheritances among them, so it is normal not to find one quickly. Fang Yuan asks after searching why he has seen only ordinary true inheritances and not unparalleled inheritances. A light lump the size of a washing basin, with a stronger aura than ordinary inheritances, is an unparalleled true inheritance.

Mo Yao names a higher level above unparalleled: supreme true inheritance. In the whole secluded domain there are only three supreme true inheritances, and she says it is simply impossible for a mortal to receive them. Fang Yuan reads a light lump the size of an adult as that supreme grade. Unparalleled true inheritances far surpass ordinary ones, and their tests are more troublesome than ordinary tests.

A ten-edge owner token can only take away an ordinary true inheritance. Even if the holder passes the test of an unparalleled true inheritance, that token cannot take it, and a mortal body cannot even endure a supreme true inheritance’s aura.
